title: Pipeline variables
description: Optional file pipelines/<pipeline>.variables.json. Tells New-PipelineVariables.ps1 which apps the pipeline deploys, which values differ for this pipeline only, and which variables it needs that a scan of its YAML cannot find.

apps.description: App folders under app-configuration/apps/ whose #{Token}# values the generated files show. Default: the app with the same name as the pipeline, when it exists.

overrides.description: Values for this pipeline only. 'common' applies to every environment, '<environment>' to one and wins over 'common'. Both win over app-configuration/variables. An environment without a variables file is ignored with a warning.

extraKeys.description: Variables to include although the scan does not find them. A name that an environment does not define is written with an empty value. '*' includes every variable of the environment.
